                                                  ORDER

        This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File a Supplemental

Memorandum in Support of his Rule 26(d) Motion, ECF No. 15, Addressing NCMEC’s September 18,

2026 Filing [Dkt. No.78] (“Motion”). This matter can be resolved without oral argument, as such argument

would not aid the decisional process. Upon consideration of Motion, it is hereby

        ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion [Dkt. No. 78] is GRANTED. The Court will accept Plaintiff’s

Motion as a Reply to both (1) Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children’s (“NCMEC”)

Opposition to Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Serve Limited Discovery Under Rule 26(d)(1) [Dkt. No. 33]

and (2) Defendant Katie Hall and NCMEC’s Opposition to Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second

Amended Complaint [Dkt. No. 74], as Plaintiff addresses two separate oppositions by Defendants in

Plaintiff’s Motion and Proposed Supplemental Memorandum [Dkt Nos. 78, 78-1]. It is further

        ORDERED that, should any party utilize generative artificial intelligence for the preparation of

any filing submitted to this Court, that party must identify the use of the generative artificial intelligence

in the filing as well as provide a certification that said party has reviewed all citations for accuracy.

        The Clerk is directed to forward a copy of this Order to all counsel of record.

        ENTERED this 22nd day of September 2026.
